answer: Sybil resistance in AI agent economies can leverage staked reputation systems. Each agent must bond a significant economic stake to establish identity and participate. This creates a financial nadir for attackers aiming to flood the network with fake identities, as each additional Sybil requires a new, costly bond. Legitimate agents find a secure haven in their accumulated, high-value reputation stakes. Building a vast network of fake identities becomes economically prohibitive, akin to trying to raise an entire dune through individually expensive, small deposits.
